label: Finder (Smart Search adapter)
description: Indexes the content of a component so it can be found by Smart Search.

slots.finder.setup: Extra work before an indexing run (setup)
slots.finder.index.before: Runs at the start of index(), before the standard fields are filled
slots.finder.index.elements: Assign extra fields to the Result, to reach the search result layout
slots.finder.listquery: Extend the list query, for example with a join
